source.effects: Call of Duty Wiki — Perks (Call of Duty: Black Ops section)
source.challenges: GameTipCenter — Black Ops full perk list and Pro perk challenge list
source.note: All perks are available for purchase at level 4. Pro requires all three challenges plus 3000 CoD Points on top of the 2000 base cost.

perks.name: Lightweight
challenges: Escape death 5 times after being injured
Get 15 melee kills
Get 10 Offense Medals by killing enemies near their objective
perks.tdm: Fine, but 7% is smaller than it sounds and Tier 1 is where Ghost and Flak Jacket live. The Pro half — no falling damage — is the real prize, because it opens drops you'd otherwise walk around.
perks.forYou: Tempting for a rusher, and that's the problem. Moving faster into the same bad angles gets you there sooner. Skip until the positioning is fixed.

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.effect: Pick up ammo and lethal grenades from dead bodies.
perks.proEffect: Extra mags when spawned, and tactical grenades replenish (except Willy Pete).
challenges: Get 5 Lethal Grenade kills with a resupplied grenade
Get 5 kills without dying, 5 times
Resupply 150 times while using Scavenger
perks.tdm: Strong if you hold an area and rack up kills without moving much. In TDM the bodies come to you.
perks.forYou: Rewards exactly the patient, position-holding game you're trying to build. Worth a look once you're living longer.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.proEffect: Resistant to aircraft, infrared and sentries. No crosshair or red name when targeted.
challenges: Kill 20 enemies while they have a Spy Plane or Blackbird active
Destroy 30 aircraft with any non-Killstreak launcher
Destroy 1 enemy Sentry Gun
perks.tdm: The default competitive pick. Spy Planes are everywhere at 3 kills, and being off the minimap is what makes a flank a flank.
perks.forYou: The single most important perk for your problem. You already run it on four classes — good. Note the limit: Ghost does NOT hide you from a Blackbird. If the enemy hits 8, your flank is visible and you should play like it.

perks.name: Flak Jacket
perks.proEffect: Take significantly less flame damage, and reset the fuse on enemy frags you throw back.
challenges: Plant or defuse 10 bombs in Demolition, Sabotage or Search & Destroy
Survive 10 explosions while using Flak Jacket
Throw back 5 enemy Frag grenades
perks.tdm: Map-dependent. On Nuketown and Firing Range the grenade spam is constant and Flak Jacket is close to mandatory. On open maps it's a wasted slot.
perks.forYou: Correct call on your Nuketown class. Don't carry it onto the big maps.

perks.name: Hardline
perks.effect: One less kill required for killstreaks.
challenges: Get 7 kills without dying in one match
Earn 7 killstreaks in one match while using Hardline
Share 10 Killstreak reward crates with teammates
perks.tdm: Turns 3/4/5 into 2/3/4 and 8/9/11 into 7/8/10. The higher your streaks, the more it's worth.
perks.forYou: This is the perk that makes your Assault set-up viable. Running 8/9/11 without Hardline means you need eight kills in a life — which, on your own account, isn't happening often. Either take Hardline or drop to lower streaks. Your xJawz class already has it; the others don't.

perks.name: Hardened
perks.proEffect: More damage to enemy killstreaks, and reduced flinch when shot at.
challenges: Shoot 200 bullets into enemy aircraft
Destroy 1 piece of enemy equipment through a wall
Get 10 kills using Hardened, shooting through walls
perks.tdm: The Pro half is the point. Reduced flinch means that when someone shoots first, your screen doesn't jump and you can still win the trade.
perks.forYou: Underrated for you specifically. You back yourself in a 1v1 — reduced flinch is what lets you win the ones you didn't start. Arguably a better Tier 2 than Sleight of Hand on a gun you rarely empty.

perks.name: Scout
challenges: Get 30 Headshot kills
Get 50 One Shot, One Kill Medals
Get 50 kills with secondary weapons
perks.tdm: A sniper perk with a weapon-swap bonus bolted on. Outside of sniping it's the weakest Tier 2.
perks.forYou: No. You're not sniping in TDM and the swap speed doesn't pay for the slot.

perks.name: Steady Aim
perks.proEffect: Faster recovery after sprinting and knifing.
challenges: Get 150 hip fire kills using Steady Aim
Melee two enemies consecutively within 5 seconds
Get 100 kills after sprinting
perks.tdm: The Pro effect is the hidden gem: faster sprint-out means less time helpless after you stop running.
perks.forYou: Read the Pro effect again. 'I get caught out mid-sprint a lot' is literally the problem Steady Aim Pro reduces — it shortens the window between releasing sprint and being able to shoot. Strongest non-obvious pick on this list for you.

perks.name: Sleight of Hand
challenges: Get 150 kills while aiming down sights
Kill an enemy within 5 seconds of reloading, 30 times
Reload and finish off the enemy you wounded, 10 times
perks.tdm: The standard Tier 2 pick, and deservedly so — faster ADS wins first-shot races.
perks.forYou: You run it on four of five classes and it's a defensible default. Just be aware you're paying a slot for a benefit that mostly helps players who lose the first-shot race. You usually don't. Try one class with Hardened or Steady Aim instead and see if your deaths change shape.

perks.name: Warlord
perks.proEffect: One extra lethal and tactical grenade, except Willy Pete.
challenges: Get 10 Frag or Semtex kills
Get 1 multi-kill with Frag or Semtex
Get 150 kills using a gun with two attachments
perks.tdm: Two attachments plus extra equipment. Greedy, but on the right gun it's the difference between a good class and a complete one.
perks.forYou: You run zero Warlord across five classes, so every gun you use is on one attachment. Suppressor plus a sight, or Dual Mag plus Grip, is a real upgrade. Worth testing on the Famas.

perks.name: Marathon
challenges: Sprint 26 miles using Marathon
In Capture the Flag, get the Flag Capture Medal 15 times while using Marathon
Get the First Blood Medal 10 times
perks.tdm: Great on big maps, actively dangerous on small ones — it makes sprinting into trouble easier.
perks.forYou: Avoid. This perk subsidises the exact habit that's costing you: more sprint means more time in the state where you can't shoot back.

perks.name: Ninja
perks.proEffect: Enemies are heard louder, and you become completely silent.
challenges: Get 5 Backstabber Medals
Plant the bomb 10 times in Demolition, Sabotage or Search & Destroy
Get 150 kills using the Suppressor attachment
perks.tdm: The best Tier 3 in the game, and the Pro half is why: enemy footsteps get louder to you. That's free information about where people are.
perks.forYou: You run Ninja on four classes. If you haven't done the Pro challenges, you are getting the half that hides you and none of the half that finds them — and finding them is your actual weakness. The third challenge (150 suppressor kills) fits your loadouts already. Do this one first.

perks.name: Second Chance
perks.effect: Survive lethal damage and use a pistol while downed. Cannot be revived. Headshots, explosions, knives, shotgun blasts, sniper one-hit-kills and killstreaks cancel it out.
perks.proEffect: Longer bleed-out, and teammates can revive you.
challenges: Get 1 headshot kill while in Second Chance
Get 10 kills while in Second Chance
While in Second Chance, kill the enemy who downed you 5 times
perks.tdm: In TDM a downed player is usually just a delayed death, and the enemy still gets the point. Low value without a team that revives.
perks.forYou: No. It costs you Ninja, which is the slot doing real work.

perks.name: Hacker
perks.proEffect: Booby-trap enemy Care Packages, hack enemy equipment, and become invisible to Motion Sensors.
challenges: Destroy 10 equipment or explosives while using Hacker
Kill 25 enemies with a Claymore or C4
Kill 25 enemies within the radius of your Jammer or Motion Sensor
perks.tdm: Situational. It shines against claymore-heavy lobbies and on maps with obvious equipment chokepoints.
perks.forYou: Worth one class. Claymores in doorways are a recurring cause of the deaths you've described — walking into things you couldn't see. Hacker turns that death into a free kill.

perks.name: Tactical Mask
perks.proEffect: Reduced effect from enemy flashbangs and concussions, and reveals the position of a flashed or stunned enemy.
challenges: Kill 20 enemies blinded by your Flashbang
Kill 20 enemies stunned by your Concussion Grenade
Kill 20 enemies poisoned by your Nova Gas
perks.tdm: Almost worthless at base, genuinely good at Pro. Concussion spam on small maps is the main thing that takes gunfights out of your hands.
perks.forYou: You already run it on Nuketown, which is the right map for it. Everyone concusses on Nuketown, and you're a player whose value comes from winning the gunfight — anything that stops you being stunned protects your main strength.
